A complete and up-to-date list of my publications is available on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=uPOL3NkAAAAJ&hl=en), including preprints.
The network below shows my main collaborators based on shared publications indexed by Google Scholar.

---

## Co-authorship network

```{r graph-data, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(scholar)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(jsonlite)

id <- 'uPOL3NkAAAAJ'
pubs <- get_publications(
  id,
  cstart = 0,
  cstop = Inf,
  pagesize = 100,
  flush = TRUE
)

# ── Fetch full author lists for truncated papers ──────────────────────────────
# Google Scholar truncates long author lists with "...". We fetch the full
# list via get_complete_authors() and fall back to the truncated string on error.
pubs$author_full <- pubs$author
trunc_idx <- grep("\\.\\.\\.", pubs$author)
for (i in trunc_idx) {
  full <- tryCatch(
    get_complete_authors(id, pubs$pubid[i]),
    error = function(e) NA_character_
  )
  if (!is.na(full) && nchar(trimws(full)) > 0) pubs$author_full[i] <- full
  Sys.sleep(0.3)
}

# ── Publication deduplication ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Google Scholar sometimes indexes both a preprint and its published version.
# We detect these by computing Jaccard title similarity between each
# preprint/working-paper and every published paper, then dropping the preprint
# when a close match (≥ 0.28) exists.

norm_title <- function(t) {
  t <- tolower(iconv(t, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT"))
  t <- gsub("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ", t)
  trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", t))
}

title_tokens <- strsplit(sapply(pubs$title, norm_title), " ")

jaccard_sim <- function(a, b) {
  a <- unique(a); b <- unique(b)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}

preprint_pat <- regex(
  "arxiv|biorxiv|medrxiv|preprint|working paper|statistics spain",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)
is_preprint   <- str_detect(pubs$journal, preprint_pat)
published_idx <- which(!is_preprint)
preprint_idx  <- which(is_preprint)

# Drop any preprint whose best title match with a published paper is ≥ 0.28
drop_rows <- Filter(function(i) {
  sims <- sapply(published_idx, function(j) jaccard_sim(title_tokens[[i]], title_tokens[[j]]))
  max(sims, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.28
}, preprint_idx)

clean_pubs <- pubs[!seq_len(nrow(pubs)) %in% drop_rows, ]

# ── Name deduplication ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Some authors appear under multiple name forms:
#   - Accent variants:  "M Martinez-Garcia" / "M Martínez-García"
#   - Initial variants: "G Collins" / "GS Collins"
#   - Abbreviation:     "JF Calatrava" / "J Fernández Calatrava"
#                       "JCGS de Cueto" / "JC Gálvez Sainz de Cueto"
#
# Strategy:
#   1. Apply manual corrections for cases that can't be resolved automatically.
#   2. Normalise accents (iconv) and lowercase to create a matching key.
#   3. Within each key-group keep the first-seen canonical form.

manual_corrections <- c(
  # Initial/abbreviation variants (can't be resolved by accent normalisation)
  "G Collins"        = "GS Collins",
  "JF Calatrava"     = "J Fernández Calatrava",
  "JCGS de Cueto"    = "JC Gálvez Sainz de Cueto",
  "JYJ Verbakel"     = "JY Verbakel",
  # Dutch/Belgian particle names — get_complete_authors absorbs "Van"/"De"
  # into initials: "B Van Calster" → "BV Calster", "B De Moor" → "BD Moor"
  "BV Calster"       = "B Van Calster",
  "BD Moor"          = "B De Moor",
  # Encoding artefact in the COVID preprint full-author scrape
  "Rén Armañanzas"   = "R Armañanzas"
)

normalize_key <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  tolower(trimws(x))
}

# Parse raw author strings (from deduplicated publication list, full author lists)
raw_names <- clean_pubs$author_full |>
  str_split(",\\s*") |>
  unlist() |>
  str_trim() |>
  (\(x) x[!str_detect(x, regex("barre[nñ]", ignore_case = TRUE))])() |>
  (\(x) x[!str_detect(x, "^\\.+$|^…$")])() |>
  (\(x) x[nchar(x) > 1])()

# Apply manual corrections
raw_names <- ifelse(
  raw_names %in% names(manual_corrections),
  manual_corrections[raw_names],
  raw_names
)

# Build canonical name map (first-seen wins within each normalised group)
canonical_map <- data.frame(
  original   = unique(raw_names),
  key        = normalize_key(unique(raw_names)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  group_by(key) |>
  summarise(canonical = first(original), .groups = "drop")

name_lookup <- setNames(canonical_map$canonical, canonical_map$key)
canonical_names <- name_lookup[normalize_key(raw_names)]

# ── Build nodes and links ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
coauthors <- sort(table(canonical_names), decreasing = TRUE) |>
  as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  setNames(c("id", "n_papers")) |>
  mutate(n_papers = as.integer(n_papers)) |>
  filter(n_papers >= 2)

nodes <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(id = "Lasai Barreñada", group = "self",     n_papers = NA_integer_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(id = coauthors$id,      group = "coauthor", n_papers = coauthors$n_papers, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
)

links <- data.frame(
  source = "Lasai Barreñada",
  target = coauthors$id,
  value  = coauthors$n_papers,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ── Build per-author publication list (for click panel) ───────────────────────
pubs_by_author <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(clean_pubs))) {
  paper_authors <- clean_pubs$author_full[i] |>
    str_split(",\\s*") |>
    unlist() |>
    str_trim() |>
    (\(x) x[!str_detect(x, regex("barre[nñ]", ignore_case = TRUE))])() |>
    (\(x) x[!str_detect(x, "^\\.+$|^…$")])() |>
    (\(x) x[nchar(x) > 1])()

  paper_authors <- ifelse(
    paper_authors %in% names(manual_corrections),
    manual_corrections[paper_authors],
    paper_authors
  )

  canonical_authors <- unique(name_lookup[normalize_key(paper_authors)])
  canonical_authors <- canonical_authors[!is.na(canonical_authors)]

  scholar_url <- paste0(
    "https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=",
    id, "&citation_for_view=", id, ":", clean_pubs$pubid[i]
  )
  paper_info <- list(title = clean_pubs$title[i], url = scholar_url)

  for (author in canonical_authors) {
    pubs_by_author[[author]] <- c(pubs_by_author[[author]], list(paper_info))
  }
}

# Add Lasai's own full publication list (shown when the centre node is clicked)
pubs_by_author[["Lasai Barreñada"]] <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(clean_pubs)), function(i) {
  list(
    title = clean_pubs$title[i],
    url   = paste0(
      "https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=",
      id, "&citation_for_view=", id, ":", clean_pubs$pubid[i]
    )
  )
})

cat(sprintf(
  "<script>\nconst graphNodes = %s;\nconst graphLinks = %s;\nconst pubsByAuthor = %s;\n</script>",
  toJSON(nodes,          auto_unbox = TRUE),
  toJSON(links,          auto_unbox = TRUE),
  toJSON(pubs_by_author, auto_unbox = TRUE)
))
```

```{=html}
<div id="graph-container" style="position: relative; width: 100%; margin: 1em 0 0.5em;">
  <div id="coauthor-graph"></div>
  <div id="graph-tooltip" style="
    position: absolute;
    background: white;
    border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    border-radius: 5px;
    padding: 7px 11px;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    pointer-events: none;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
    max-width: 220px;
    z-index: 10;
  "></div>
</div>

<!-- Publication panel (shown on node click) -->
<div id="pub-panel" style="
  display: none;
  margin-bottom: 2em;
  border: 1px solid #c4d8ed;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #f4f8fd;
  padding: 0.9em 1.2em;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  animation: fadeIn 0.18s ease;
">
  <style>@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }</style>
  <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; margin-bottom:0.5em;">
    <span style="font-weight:600; font-size:14px; color:#1a6eaa;">
      Publications with <span id="panel-author"></span>
    </span>
    <button onclick="document.getElementById('pub-panel').style.display='none'; window._clearSelectedNode && window._clearSelectedNode();"
      style="background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:18px; color:#999; line-height:1; padding:0 2px;">×</button>
  </div>
  <ul id="panel-list" style="margin:0; padding-left:1.3em;"></ul>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/dist/d3.min.js"></script>

<script>
(function () {
  const W = 860, H = 540;
  const DIM_OPACITY = 0.12;
  const FOCUS_MS = 300;

  const container = document.getElementById("graph-container");
  const tooltip   = d3.select("#graph-tooltip");

  const svg = d3.select("#coauthor-graph")
    .append("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", "100%")
    .style("background", "#f4f8fd")
    .style("border-radius", "8px");

  // ── SVG Defs: radial gradients + filters ──────────────────────────────
  const defs = svg.append("defs");

  // Drop shadow for coauthor nodes
  const shadow = defs.append("filter")
    .attr("id", "node-shadow")
    .attr("x", "-40%").attr("y", "-40%")
    .attr("width", "180%").attr("height", "180%");
  shadow.append("feDropShadow")
    .attr("dx", 0).attr("dy", 1)
    .attr("stdDeviation", 3)
    .attr("flood-color", "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)");

  // Glow filter for centre node
  const glow = defs.append("filter")
    .attr("id", "center-glow")
    .attr("x", "-50%").attr("y", "-50%")
    .attr("width", "200%").attr("height", "200%");
  glow.append("feGaussianBlur")
    .attr("in", "SourceGraphic")
    .attr("stdDeviation", 4)
    .attr("result", "blur");
  glow.append("feMerge")
    .selectAll("feMergeNode")
    .data(["blur", "SourceGraphic"])
    .join("feMergeNode")
    .attr("in", d => d);

  // ── Scales ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const maxP = d3.max(graphNodes.filter(d => d.group !== "self"), d => d.n_papers) || 1;

  const colorScale = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([1, maxP])
    .range(["#93c4e8", "#1a6eaa"]);

  const rScale = d3.scaleSqrt()
    .domain([1, maxP])
    .range([8, 20]);

  const CENTER_R = 32;

  function surname(name) {
    const m = name.match(/^[A-Z.]+\s+(.*)/);
    return m ? m[1] : name;
  }

  // ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const nodes = graphNodes.map(d => ({ ...d }));
  const links = graphLinks.map(d => ({ ...d }));

  const center = nodes.find(d => d.group === "self");
  center.fx = W / 2;
  center.fy = H / 2;

  // Create a radial gradient per node (lighter centre → base colour edge)
  nodes.forEach((d, i) => {
    const base = d.group === "self" ? "#007BFF" : colorScale(d.n_papers);
    const light = d3.color(base).brighter(0.6).formatHex();
    const grad = defs.append("radialGradient")
      .attr("id", `node-grad-${i}`)
      .attr("cx", "35%").attr("cy", "35%").attr("r", "65%");
    grad.append("stop").attr("offset", "0%").attr("stop-color", light);
    grad.append("stop").attr("offset", "100%").attr("stop-color", base);
  });

  // ── Simulation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sim = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
    .force("link",      d3.forceLink(links).id(d => d.id)
                          .distance(d => 95 + (maxP - d.value) * 18))
    .force("charge",    d3.forceManyBody().strength(-260))
    .force("center",    d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2))
    .force("collision", d3.forceCollide(d =>
      d.group === "self" ? CENTER_R + 14 : rScale(d.n_papers) + 14));

  // ── Selection / focus state ───────────────────────────────────────────
  let selectedNode = null;
  let mouseDownXY  = null;

  function getConnected(d) {
    const ids = new Set([d.id]);
    links.forEach(l => {
      const s = typeof l.source === "object" ? l.source.id : l.source;
      const t = typeof l.target === "object" ? l.target.id : l.target;
      if (s === d.id) ids.add(t);
      if (t === d.id) ids.add(s);
    });
    return ids;
  }

  function applyFocus(focusNode) {
    const conn = getConnected(focusNode);
    nodeSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS)
      .style("opacity", n => conn.has(n.id) ? 1 : DIM_OPACITY);
    linkSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS)
      .style("opacity", l => {
        const s = typeof l.source === "object" ? l.source.id : l.source;
        const t = typeof l.target === "object" ? l.target.id : l.target;
        return (s === focusNode.id || t === focusNode.id) ? 0.75 : DIM_OPACITY;
      });
    labelSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS)
      .style("opacity", n => conn.has(n.id) ? 1 : DIM_OPACITY);
  }

  function restoreFull() {
    nodeSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS).style("opacity", 1);
    linkSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS).style("opacity", 0.75);
    labelSel.transition().duration(FOCUS_MS).style("opacity", 1);
  }

  function clearSelection() {
    if (selectedNode) {
      nodeSel.filter(n => n.id === selectedNode.id)
        .attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
      selectedNode = null;
    }
    document.getElementById("pub-panel").style.display = "none";
    restoreFull();
  }

  window._clearSelectedNode = clearSelection;

  function showPanel(d) {
    const papers = pubsByAuthor[d.id] || [];
    document.getElementById("panel-author").textContent = d.id;
    document.getElementById("panel-list").innerHTML = papers
      .map(p => `<li><a href="${p.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${p.title}</a></li>`)
      .join("");
    const panel = document.getElementById("pub-panel");
    panel.style.display = "block";
    panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
  }

  // ── Links (curved paths) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const linkSel = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(links)
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "#c4d8ed")
      .attr("stroke-width", d => Math.sqrt(d.value) * 1.8)
      .style("opacity", 0);

  function linkPath(d, i) {
    const sx = d.source.x, sy = d.source.y;
    const tx = d.target.x, ty = d.target.y;
    const dx = tx - sx, dy = ty - sy;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    const sign = i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const off  = dist * 0.1 * sign;
    const mx = (sx + tx) / 2 + (-dy / dist) * off;
    const my = (sy + ty) / 2 + ( dx / dist) * off;
    return `M ${sx},${sy} Q ${mx},${my} ${tx},${ty}`;
  }

  // ── Nodes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const nodeSel = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("r", 0)
      .attr("fill",         (d, i) => `url(#node-grad-${i})`)
      .attr("stroke",       "#fff")
      .attr("stroke-width", 2)
      .attr("filter", d => d.group === "self" ? "url(#center-glow)" : "url(#node-shadow)")
      .style("cursor", "pointer")
    .on("mouseover", function (event, d) {
      if (selectedNode && selectedNode.id === d.id) return;
      d3.select(this).attr("stroke", "#ffcc00").attr("stroke-width", 3);
      if (!selectedNode) applyFocus(d);
      const [x, y] = d3.pointer(event, container);
      if (d.group === "self") {
        tooltip
          .html(`<strong>Lasai Barreñada</strong><br/><em style="color:#888;font-size:11px">Click to see all publications</em>`)
          .style("opacity", 1)
          .style("left", (x + 14) + "px")
          .style("top",  (y - 52) + "px");
      } else {
        tooltip
          .html(`<strong>${d.id}</strong><br/>
                 ${d.n_papers} shared publication${d.n_papers > 1 ? "s" : ""}<br/>
                 <em style="color:#888;font-size:11px">Click to see papers</em>`)
          .style("opacity", 1)
          .style("left", (x + 14) + "px")
          .style("top",  (y - 52) + "px");
      }
    })
    .on("mouseout", function (event, d) {
      tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
      if (selectedNode && selectedNode.id === d.id) return;
      d3.select(this).attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
      if (selectedNode) applyFocus(selectedNode);
      else restoreFull();
    })
    .on("mousedown.clicktrack", (event) => {
      mouseDownXY = [event.clientX, event.clientY];
    })
    .on("click", function (event, d) {
      if (mouseDownXY) {
        const moved = Math.hypot(
          event.clientX - mouseDownXY[0],
          event.clientY - mouseDownXY[1]
        );
        mouseDownXY = null;
        if (moved > 5) return;
      }
      event.stopPropagation();

      if (selectedNode && selectedNode.id === d.id) { clearSelection(); return; }

      if (selectedNode) {
        nodeSel.filter(n => n.id === selectedNode.id)
          .attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
      }

      selectedNode = d;
      d3.select(this).attr("stroke", "#ffcc00").attr("stroke-width", 3);
      applyFocus(d);
      showPanel(d);
    })
    .call(drag(sim));

  svg.on("click", () => clearSelection());

  // ── Labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const labelSel = svg.append("g")
    .attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("text")
      .text(d => d.group === "self" ? "Lasai" : surname(d.id))
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-size",   d => d.group === "self" ? "13px" : "10px")
      .attr("font-weight", d => d.group === "self" ? "bold" : "normal")
      .attr("fill",        d => d.group === "self" ? "#fff" : "#333")
      .style("opacity", 0);

  // ── Tick ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  sim.on("tick", () => {
    nodes.forEach(d => {
      if (d.group !== "self") {
        const r = rScale(d.n_papers) + 16;
        d.x = Math.max(r, Math.min(W - r, d.x));
        d.y = Math.max(r, Math.min(H - r, d.y));
      }
    });
    linkSel.attr("d", linkPath);
    nodeSel
      .attr("cx", d => d.x)
      .attr("cy", d => d.y);
    labelSel
      .attr("x", d => d.x)
      .attr("y", d => d.group === "self"
        ? d.y + 4.5
        : d.y - rScale(d.n_papers) - 4);
  });

  // ── Entrance animation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  setTimeout(() => {
    linkSel.transition().duration(600).ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
      .style("opacity", 0.75);
    nodeSel.transition().duration(700).ease(d3.easeBackOut.overshoot(0.6))
      .attr("r", d => d.group === "self" ? CENTER_R : rScale(d.n_papers));
    labelSel.transition().duration(700).delay(200).ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
      .style("opacity", 1);
  }, 400);

  // ── Drag ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function drag(simulation) {
    return d3.drag()
      .on("start", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
        if (d.group !== "self") { d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y; }
      })
      .on("drag", (event, d) => {
        if (d.group !== "self") { d.fx = event.x; d.fy = event.y; }
      })
      .on("end", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
        if (d.group !== "self") { d.fx = null; d.fy = null; }
      });
  }

  // ── Legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(14, ${H - 78})`);

  legend.append("rect")
    .attr("width", 178).attr("height", 68).attr("rx", 5)
    .attr("fill", "#fff").attr("fill-opacity", 0.9);

  legend.append("circle").attr("cx", 14).attr("cy", 20).attr("r", 8)
    .attr("fill", "#93c4e8");
  legend.append("text").attr("x", 28).attr("y", 24)
    .text("2 shared papers").attr("font-size", "11px").attr("fill", "#444");

  legend.append("circle").attr("cx", 14).attr("cy", 46).attr("r", 12)
    .attr("fill", "#1a6eaa");
  legend.append("text").attr("x", 28).attr("y", 50)
    .text("Many shared papers").attr("font-size", "11px").attr("fill", "#444");

  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", W - 10).attr("y", H - 10)
    .attr("text-anchor", "end")
    .attr("font-size", "11px").attr("fill", "#aaa")
    .text("Drag to rearrange · click any node to see publications");
})();
</script>
```
